# Federation Congress Reviews Regional Trade Preferences

The Arennian Federation's Congress has begun its annual review of trade preferences for the countries of Arvane. Kunasaian exporters of grain and textiles benefit most from the current rules. Diplomats say the review is routine. Exporters in Tapira are following it closely.
